source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies the unrestricted binary two-arm finite-population game, reduces it to X=p+Binomial(r,1/2), and proves rho*_n=n^{-1}-C_A n^{-4/3}+o(n^{-4/3}) attained by Bernoulli(1/2) randomization and nonlinear shrinkage.

Hull’s Theorem 1 optimizes the bounded two-arm problem over all measurable estimators and gives a finite reduced program; the paper states independent random assignment remains minimax in that two-arm setting.
Under permutation-invariant distribution classes, Bai’s general optimization result yields complete randomization; the displayed applications use linear estimators and Neyman allocation.
